remarks: An incredible opportunity awaits at 185 Newtown Avenue--perfect for investors or handy buyers looking to unlock this home's full potential. This spacious split-style property, spanning over 3,000 square feet, is perched on a third of an acre with stunning views of a serene pond. The layout is ideal for multi-generational living, offering generous space throughout and perfect for entertaining large gatherings of friends. The main level features a large living room, dining room, and kitchen, which flows into a bright family room. Complete with a fireplace, the family room opens to a deck that overlooks the backyard, perfect for outdoor gatherings and relaxation. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, including the primary suite, as well as two full bathrooms. Each room at the back of the house offers picturesque water views. The lower level adds even more versatility, with a bedroom, a den, a full bath, and a laundry room with access to the backyard and the pond. This space, along with its separate entrance to the attached one-car garage, could serve as an in-law suite, playroom, or cozy den. Beyond the home itself, the location is unbeatable. Nestled in the sought-after Cranbury neighborhood, you're close to all of Norwalk's best amenities. Stew Leonard's is just two minutes away, and you can reach the beach in under ten minutes. This home offers endless potential--come and transform it into the dream home it was meant to be!
